description: Details of one published memorial: dates, life story (obituary, shortened if long), service details, how many tributes it has, the funeral home and the link. Details the family keeps for QR code visitors are left out.

id.description: Memorial id from search_memorials, the memorial's link, or the last part of it (for example "example" in /memorials/example)

region.description: "au" for Australia (foreverinourhearts.com.au), "global" for every other country (foreverinourhearts.co). Omit to search both

name: get_memorial
title: Get a memorial
